name: agentskillshub
description: Search, security-audit, and get install commands for 267,000+ open-source AI agent skills, Claude Skills, and MCP servers indexed by Agent Skills Hub (agentskillshub.top).

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Find open-source AI agent skills and MCP servers by natural-language query with optional category, platform, star, quality, and security grade filters.

tools.name: audit_skill
tools.description: Run a free security trust check for a skill returning security grade (safe, caution, unsafe, reject, unaudited), plain-English verdict, and quality score.

tools.name: get_skill_install
tools.description: Get install commands and a pre-install safety verification checklist for an indexed skill.

tools.name: pro_search
tools.description: Deep search across the full README text of the indexed catalog, with category and security-grade filters (requires ASH_PRO_KEY).

instructions: Connect directly via MCP Streamable HTTP at https://agentskillshub.top/mcp (no authentication required; e.g. `claude mcp add --transport http agentskillshub https://agentskillshub.top/mcp`), or run the local stdio server via `npx -y @agentskillshub/mcp` (supports optional ASH_PRO_KEY for pro_search).
